items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They had Specs Wright on drums... so I met a lot of those people when I was a kid.

ctx.x: ... who was a complete nut. And he took me up there, I was underage but he took me up there. They had Specs Wright on drums, Jimmy Golden, pianist, and Jimmy Oliver, tenor saxophonist. Of course Jimmy Heath was up there a lot, and all kinds of great musicians. Red Rodney, so I met a lot of those people when I was a kid. But I
actually, even though I saw Jimmy Heath, I didn’t meet him until Chicago.
